# The cave: a faceted floor 14 x 10 m (top at y 0, verts jittered so facets catch the light), a
# rim of boulders round the arena ellipse (taller at the back) and a second ring in the corners,
# glow-worm specks (unlit) on the boulders' upper faces. Generated by make_env.py. Up Z, front -Y.
new
material new Floor --base-color 1 1 1 --no-slot
material new Rock --base-color 0.2667 0.3020 0.5176 --no-slot
material new Speck --base-color 0.6980 0.8353 0.8196 --no-slot --emission 0.6980 0.8353 0.8196
add mesh grid --name Floor --x-subdivisions 40 --y-subdivisions 30 --size 1
scale 14 10 1
apply --scale
set location 0 -0.250 0
apply --location
material assign Floor
material texture Floor base-color floor.png
mode edit
select all
uv project-from-view top --scale-to-bounds
randomize --amount 0.07 --seed 4
mode object
add mesh ico-sphere --name Rock0 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.624 --location 4.824 -0.238 0 --rotation 35 11 92
apply --rotation
scale 1.09 1.05 1.12
apply --scale

delete only-faces
